name: fframes
use_label: Fast GPU video, written in Rust and SVG
one_liner: A video framework where you write in Rust and SVG and render on the GPU, built for briefing a coding agent.

text.why: Building video from a web page in a browser takes a long time to render. fframes has you write the video in Rust and SVG and render it on the GPU; the README says a 128-second video rendered in 36 seconds.
text.take: You brief it the way you would brief a motion designer.
build: Add the agent skill once and your agent installs it, creates a project, designs the motion, places the sound and checks the result. Because an agent cannot watch video, commands like inspect and strip turn it into PNGs and numbers it can read.

who.role: Developers who want a coding agent to produce video.

start.text: Run npx skills add https://fframes.studio, then describe the video you want to your agent.

caveat: Rust-based, and the README itself says the API is explicit and verbose. GPU requirements and supported operating systems are not stated in the README.

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
